# A view-body return used to reach codegen: bubbletea emitted a View() calling
# a renderMain it never defined, and generate exited 0 on Go that does not
# compile. The exit code is the assertion.
! sngl generate --platform=bubbletea --lang=go --out=out ret.sngl
stderr 'a return is not a statement in a view body'
! exists out/model.go

# The same for an assignment, which fyne wrote into its builder while
# bubbletea and html dropped it.
! sngl generate --platform=bubbletea --lang=go --out=out2 assign.sngl
stderr 'an assignment to "n" is not a statement in a view body'

# Moved into an effect, the same write generates.
sngl generate --platform=bubbletea --lang=go --out=out3 effect.sngl
exists out3/model.go
grep 'm\.n = 5' out3/model.go

-- ret.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import app "sngl:app"

component main ui {
    return

    text(value="hi")
}

app.window {
    main
}
-- assign.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import app "sngl:app"

var n = 0

component main ui {
    n = 5

    text(value="{n}")
}

app.window {
    main
}
-- effect.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import app "sngl:app"

var n = 0

component main ui {
    effect(@mount {
        n = 5
    })

    text(value="{n}")
}

app.window {
    main
}
